packageRules.description: Go module dependencies are not managed by version bumps. A bump PR says a new release exists, not that anything here is affected. govulncheck.yml answers the security half by reachability, latest-deps.yml answers the compatibility half by running the tests against the newest versions nightly. See https://words.filippo.io/dependabot/.

The toolchain directive is the exception. govulncheck judges the standard library against whatever it names, and goreleaser builds release binaries with it, so a stale value ships known-vulnerable binaries. Renovate does not touch the go directive, which stays a floor rather than a target.
Action bumps arrive as one PR rather than one per action.
